summary.text: Venicia Considine is a Democratic Nevada Assembly member from District 18 who has served since November 2020 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney, she chairs the Government Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: Considine was born in Flushing, Queens, New York, and lives in Las Vegas, Nevada.
She earned a B.A. and M.A. in American history and a J.D. from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, in 1997, 2002 and 2008, respectively.
Her career experience includes working as an attorney and director of development.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she said she worked full-time and attended UNLV part-time for seven years, attended UNLV's part-time night law program, and had worked at the Legal Aid Center of Southern Nevada for 14 years.
Considine assumed office on November 4, 2020, succeeding Richard Carrillo.
For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Government Affairs Committee as chair, the Natural Resources Committee, and the Revenue Committee as vice chair.
